svg.text: mini-WAM: acting and imagining in one sequence
One transformer predicts the action chunk and denoises the next 5 frames.
mini-FM's tokens, then the future frames'
noised to a random step t
Transformer blocks ×4, shared by every token
attention masked as in the panel below
Acting never looks at the future
So acting drops the frame tokens
image: sees all of mini-FM's tokens; text, class: causal
